title: Fixture case index
description: Implementation-neutral case list for one fixture family. Each case is input -> expected behavior; never a vector-store payload schema.

id.description: Globally unique fixture id across all families.

status.description: active = v0 expected behavior; deferred = kept for reference, not a v0 gate (15 §3).

input.description: Neutral input: tree / event / query / request. May embed a declarative tree or reference input_path.

expected.description: Observable expected behavior/outcome. No internal payload field names.

source.description: v1 file the assertion was imported from.

ref.description: Test name / describe block / line hint in the source.
